issues.detail: The Greek 'ου τη σαρκι του' (not to the flesh) is an object of the verb 'οφειλεται' (owe/debt). The Vietnamese translation 'không phải của xác thịt' (not of the flesh) changes the grammatical relationship from a debt owed *to* someone into a description of what we are *not*. In Greek, the debt is to the flesh; in Vietnamese, it reads as if we are not 'of' the flesh.
